original_ai_output.title_zh: 西班牙警方在国王访问前清理休达最后一处移民海滩营地
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 西班牙警方于周日清理了其北非飞地休达海滩上的最后一处移民营地，此举发生在国王访问之前。该营地是在7月底超过7万人从邻国摩洛哥大规模涌入后形成的。此次突然涌入造成数十人死亡，引发欧盟警觉并在马德里触发政治危机。

location.raw_text: a beach in its North African enclave of Ceuta

key_facts.fact: 西班牙警方清理了休达海滩上的最后一处移民营地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Spanish police on Sunday cleared the last migrant camp on a beach in its North African enclave of Ceuta, ahead of a visit by the king.

key_facts.fact: 该营地是在7月底超过7万人从摩洛哥涌入后形成的
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It sprang up after a mass influx of more than 70,000 people into the territory from neighbouring Morocco at the end of July.

key_facts.fact: 此次涌入造成数十人死亡并引发欧盟警觉和马德里政治危机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The sudden influx, during which scores of people died, sparked alarm across the European Union and triggered a political crisis in Madrid.

uncertainties: 事件为单一来源报道，尚未获得交叉验证
